svg.title: Otabek Jurabekov, backend engineer and competitive programmer from Tashkent
svg.text: Backend engineer building fintech at Revolution Group.
Competitive programmer: IOI 2023, ICPC regional gold.
The word “algorithm” comes from al-Khwārizmī of Khwarazm, today’s Uzbekistan.
